routes.name: Short Stay (up to 3 months)
routes.summary: Stays up to 3 months need no residence permit. Whether you need a visa depends on your nationality. The pages read did not give the visa list.

other: Visa requirement by nationality not confirmed on the pages read. Check with the Migration and Passport Office.

sources.label: Migration and Passport Office, residing in Liechtenstein

routes.name: EEA and Swiss Residence (quota system)
routes.summary: EEA citizens can live in Liechtenstein under yearly quotas. Half the permits go by lottery and half are granted by the Government. Swiss citizens have their own quota.

other: EEA yearly quota: at least 56 permits for work and 16 for non-working residence granted by the Government, plus lottery permits.
Swiss: at least 12 work and 5 non-working permits per year.
Work applications are decided monthly, non-working quarterly.

sources.label: Migration and Passport Office, residing in Liechtenstein

routes.name: Residence for Third-Country Nationals
routes.summary: No right to a permit. The Government may grant one for employed work or non-working residence, weighing the national economy, or for people of particular interest to the country.

other: Spouse and joint single children under 18 can be included.

sources.label: Migration and Passport Office, residing in Liechtenstein

routes.name: Residence Permit B Without Gainful Employment
routes.summary: For people who do not work in Liechtenstein and have enough money not to need social assistance. Valid for more than 12 months. Working is prohibited. Decided once a quarter.

other: Enough financial resources to avoid social assistance. No specific amount on the page.
Subject to quotas and a draw for EEA nationals.

fees.label: Advance payment with application (CHF 80 charged if refused)

sources.label: Residence permit B without gainful employment

routes.name: Permanent Residence and Establishment
routes.summary: Five years of stay is the threshold for EEA, Swiss and third-country nationals. Apply at least 14 days before your permit expires. Language requirements were not on the page.

other: Five years of residence for all groups.
Language or other conditions not stated on the page. Contact bewilligungen.apa@llv.li.

routes.name: Naturalization
routes.summary: Four routes: marriage or registered partnership (simplified), long-term residence (simplified), statelessness (simplified) and the standard procedure. Start with an inquiry form to the Civil Registry Office. Registration is separate for people with Liechtenstein ancestors.

other: Years, language and test details were not on the pages read. A civics test exists under the Migration and Passport Office integration pages.
Governed by the Citizenship Act of 1934 (BüG).

citizenship.note: Dual citizenship rules not confirmed from official pages read.

steps: Submit the inquiry form to the Civil Registry Office
Read their reply on procedure and documents
